Both agents subsequently reread the final source hashes and audited their existing artifacts against the added numbering rules. Final source hashes identify this subsequent audit, not the original generation. See sessions.
audit_source:
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); ev=root/'.scratch/ticket-harness/evidence'
commits=['7f4eac0','a45dac0','70a0122','fe036e3','552fcd6','bb982c0']
result={'baseline':'2e15004338b45d61719656de113c2cbfdea56345','commits':{},'tickets':{}}
for sha in commits:
 full=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',sha],text=True).strip()
 subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',full,result['baseline']],check=True)
 result['commits'][sha]=full
for num,count in [('09',6),('10',6),('11',6)]:
 ticket=next((root/'.scratch/ticket-harness/issues').glob(f'{num}-*.md'))
 text=ticket.read_text(); ac=text.split('## Acceptance criteria')[1].split('\n## ')[0]
 assert ac.count('- [x]')==count and '- [ ]' not in ac
 assert '**Status:** completed' in text
 record=(ev/f'{num}-completion.md').read_text()
 assert 'Spec' in record and 'Standards' in record
 result['tickets'][num]={'path':str(ticket.relative_to(root)),'checked':count,'completion_sha256':hashlib.sha256(record.encode()).hexdigest(),'checks_sha256':hashlib.sha256((ev/f'{num}-checks.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
d=json.loads((ev/'09-fixture-observations.json').read_text())
assert d['implementation_revision']==result['commits']['7f4eac0'] and len(d['scenarios'])==21
result['09_scenarios']=len(d['scenarios'])
for file,sha in d['tested_source_identity']['files'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f"7f4eac0:{file}"])).hexdigest()==sha
for num,file in [('10','10-planning-observations.json'),('11','11-handoff-observations.json')]:
 d=json.loads((ev/file).read_text())
 for source,sha in d['source_sha256'].items():
  revision='70a0122' if num=='10' else '552fcd6'
  assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{revision}:{source}'])).hexdigest()==sha
 if num=='10':
  assert d['feedback_approved_inputs_unchanged'] and d['feedback_new_issues_published']==0
  result['10_provenance']=d['provenance']
 else:
  assert set(d['results'])=={'normal','waiting','final'}
  result['11_scenarios']=list(d['results'])
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'docs/agents/issue-tracker.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='3803de99e541e60d2e9f733d5c98b009a43e60a9584e3819adffc55eae0214ce'
result['unrelated_tracker_edit_preserved']=True
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
